text: Eric Carle's Draw Me a Star has been banned in at least four school districts since 2021, including districts in Florida, Iowa, and Texas, where the book's naked couple led some schools to cover it in paper clothes. It was challenged several times in Carle's lifetime. In 1996 a parent in a Seattle suburb called it "soft pornography" that might encourage children to draw naked bodies. In 1999 it was challenged but retained in the Dorothy B. Bunce Elementary School library in Pavilion, N.Y., despite a parent's objection to a collage picture of a naked man and woman representing Adam and Eve.
meta_description: Draw Me a Star by Eric Carle: banned in at least four school districts since 2021; challenged in 1996 and 1999 but retained in Pavilion, N.Y.
